title: A Primer of the Paired Short Blades
summary: Teaches a first-time student to hold a short blade in each fist and strike with either hand using body strength alone.

title: Drill-Book of the Knuckle Guard
summary: Drills the use of the knuckle guard to block and to hook so a beginner learns the close-work habits of the pair.

title: Handbook of the Reverse Grip
summary: Shows how to turn each short blade point-back along the forearm for hidden cuts and close covering guards.

title: Wrist and Forearm Conditioning for Close Blades
summary: Builds the wrist and forearm strength that two short blades demand and turns each exercise into a usable close technique.

title: A Plain Treatise on Crowded Rooms and Short Swords
summary: Sets out how to fight with a pair of short blades where there is no space to swing a long weapon.

title: The Beginner's Pair-Hold Workbook
summary: Gives an untrained student slow counted exercises for moving the two blades one after the other without tangling them.

title: Qi Threading for the Pair of Short Blades
summary: Teaches a newly awakened student to thread circulating qi along both short blades during plain cuts and guards.

title: Canon of the Hinge Step
summary: Trains a footwork of short pivots and hinged turns that keeps both blades facing the opponent while qi steadies the body.

title: Handbook of Edge and Guard in Alternation
summary: Alternates a cutting blade and a guarding blade so that each hand learns both jobs with a little qi behind it.

title: Primer of the Wing Cut
summary: Introduces the opening and closing cut of both blades together and the qi breath that carries it.

title: A Workbook of Entering Blades
summary: Drills the entry past an opponent's reach and the clinging work that keeps the pair of blades at close range.
